image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white electric steam iron resting on a patterned fabric surface. The image focuses on the handle, the upper body, and the reflective chrome soleplate. A power cord with a beige/white braided or dotted texture extends from the rear. A label with text is visible on the side of the iron's body.

The cord has an unusual 'dotted' or 'braided' texture that looks more like a decorative rope than a standard rubber/plastic electrical cord. It lacks the smoothness expected of this component.
The geometry under the handle arch is ambiguous. The 'dial' seems to float or merge awkwardly with the body, and the structural support for the handle lacks clear mechanical logic.

To rigorously analyze the gibberish text on the side label, which is a primary artifact indicator.
To check for edge bleeding between the reflective soleplate and the background, and to verify the continuity of the plastic body.
To assess the realism of the reflections on the metal and the texture of the cord.

Physical plausibility of the power cord texture and connection point.
